description: Booked date ranges and open windows for the three homes, from the live calendars (refreshed every 30 minutes). Ranges are start to end with end exclusive: a checkout day is open for a new check in. openWindows lists every gap at least as long as that home's minimum stay inside the window you ask for (default today plus 180 days, longest 400). A window flagged clippedAtWindowEnd may continue past your 'to' date. Homes: Happy Island Cottage (happy-island-cottage, sleeps 6, 7 night minimum); Happy Turtle A (happy-turtle-a, sleeps 5, 3 night minimum); Happy Turtle B (happy-turtle-b, sleeps 4, 3 night minimum).

from.description: First day to look at, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

property.description: happy-island-cottage = Happy Island Cottage, sleeps 6; happy-turtle-a = Happy Turtle A, sleeps 5; happy-turtle-b = Happy Turtle B, sleeps 4

to.description: Last day, exclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (default from plus 180 days)
